Unknown ([[JN145]])| java1=[[Mika Kanai]]| }} '''James's Yamask''' (Japanese: '''コジロウのデスマス''' ''Kojirō's Desumasu'') is the first Pokémon that [[James]] caught in the [[Unova]] region, and his tenth overall. ==History== ==={{aniseries|BW}}=== ====Unova==== [[File:James Yamask commanding Litwick.png|thumb|left|250px|Yamask commanding the Litwick]] Yamask first appeared before Team Rocket in a warehouse in ''[[BW023|Battling For The Love of Bug-Types!]]''. {{MTR}} suggested that they capture him to increase their strength. [[Jessie]] agreed and called out her {{TP|Jessie|Woobat}} to battle him, but James claimed he was hungry and he proceeded to feed him. Once he was full, he happily went into James's {{i|Poké Ball}}, the trio welcoming their newest addition with enthusiasm. In ''[[BW026|Scare at the Litwick Mansion!]]'', Yamask befriended a group of {{p|Litwick}} in a mansion that Team Rocket was temporarily using as a base. However, he was kidnapped by the Candle Pokémon in an apparent attempt to lure James, Jessie, and Meowth into a trap. Yamask teamed up with Jessie's Woobat, {{AP|Oshawott}}, {{AP|Pikachu}}, and {{TP|Cilan|Dwebble}} to defeat the Litwick and their {{p|Lampent}} leader. Yamask had its first battle against {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} in ''[[BW027|The Dragon Master's Path!]]'', where it joined forces with Woobat to capture [[Iris's Axew]] and [[Emmy]]'s {{p|Druddigon}}. The two dragons later escaped, and Yamask and Woobat follow in hot pursuit. The two managed to overpower Axew and Druddigon at first, but Yamask ended up fainting when Druddigon learned {{m|Draco Meteor}}. Yamask was used in ''[[BW075|A Restoration Confrontation! Part 1]]'' to capture a {{p|Tirtouga}} that [[Dr. Zager]] had just resurrected, however it escaped after blowing a hole in the helicopter with {{m|Ancient Power}}. In [[BW076|the next episode]], Yamask ambushed [[Ferris]] and the group with {{m|Night Shade}} and battled to capture the Prototurtle Pokémon alongside Woobat. After Tirtouga evolved into {{p|Carracosta}} and fled the scene, Yamask used his {{m|Haze}} to stop {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} from following {{TRT}}. Yamask later battled Pikachu and {{TP|Cilan|Pansage}}, revealing his {{m|Will-O-Wisp}} attack, as they tried to rescue the captured Carracosta before the time gate at [[Twist Mountain]]. [[File:Jessie Woobat James Yamask ambush.png|250px|thumb|Yasmask and Woobat ambushing Ash in order to steal Meloetta]] Sometime before ''[[BW082|An Epic Defense Force!]]'', Team Rocket began tracking {{an|Meloetta}} for their latest plan, Operation Tempest. Yamask helped kidnap Meletta by distracting Meloetta's protector, [[Ridley]], with his Haze attack. He [[BW085|later]] teamed up with Woobat to expose the Melody Pokémon. Meowth tried to catch it in an electric net but Meloetta escaped through its invisibility. In ''[[BW096|Meloetta and the Undersea Temple!]]'', Yamask and Woobat confronted Ash and his friends so that Team Rocket could steal Meloetta. He battled against Iris's Axew and Cilan's Pansage while {{an|Giovanni}} pursued Ash and Meloetta. Then in the [[BW097|next episode]] Yamask and Woobat used their combined attacks to launch Ash off the top of the ancient temple to prevent him from interfering with Operation Tempest. When Team Rocket were finally defeated, Yamask allowed them to retreat by concealing them all with Haze. After the operation failed, Yamask joined James in retreating to [[Kanto]]. When James returned to Unova in ''[[BW109|New Places...Familiar Faces!]]'', he brought Yamask with him, as revealed in ''[[BW115|The Pokémon Harbor Patrol!]]'', where he used Will-O-Wisp against Ash's Oshawott during an attempt to steal Pikachu. Yamask also helped to fight off [[Team Plasma]]'s controlled Pokémon in ''[[BW122|What Lies Beyond Truth and Ideals!]]''. ====Decolore Islands==== In ''[[BW139|Team Rocket's Shocking Recruit!]]'', Yamask battled Ash and {{ashfr}} for the final time in Unova. Team Rocket had managed to trap Iris's Axew and {{TP|Iris|Emolga}}, and [[Ash's Snivy]] stepped up to save them. Yamask tried to stop her with Shadow Ball, but was pushed back by multiple {{m|Vine Whip}}s and a {{m|Leaf Storm}}. The Pokémon were then freed by a variety of attacks and Team Rocket was blasted off. Yamask appeared in ''[[BW142|The Dream Continues!]]'', where he attacked Ash, {{an|Professor Oak}}, and [[Alexa]] with Will-O-Wisp. Later in the episode, he was given away to Giovanni for Team Rocket's cause. ==={{aniseries|JN}}=== In ''[[JN145|Rocket Revengers!]]'', Yamask, alongside the rest of Team Rocket's Pokémon at {{an|Team Rocket HQ}}, were sent to Jessie and James so they could be added back to their team. Realizing the potential of such a large group, the team hatched a scheme to isolate Ash's Pikachu and capture him. Yamask and {{TP|Jessie|Frillish}} were the second to do so, distracting {{an|Misty}} and her Pokémon while Ash and Pikachu ran ahead. Upon getting a distress signal from {{TP|Jessie|Gourgeist}}, the two returned to their Trainers to take on Pikachu as a group. He joined all of Team Rocket to launch a combined attack at the Mouse Pokémon. However, it was dodged, and {{TP|Jessie|Wobbuffet}} ended up sending it back with {{m|Mirror Coat}}. A wild {{an|Latias}} that had been following Ash then intervened and sent the evil group blasting off. ==Personality and characteristics== [[File:James and Yamask.png|thumb|left|250px|Yamask and James]] [[File:James Yamask shield.png|thumb|250px|Yamask using his mask as a shield]] Like many of James's Pokémon before him, Yamask is very friendly and is shown to have a great relationship with his Trainer. He is a very thankful Pokémon, as shown when he let James catch him after he was given some food. Unlike several of James's other Pokémon, such as {{TP|James|Victreebel}}, {{TP|James|Cacnea}}, and {{TP|James|Carnivine}}, Yamask doesn't show any kind of special affection to James when coming out of his Poké Ball. As seen in ''[[BW037|A Fishing Connoisseur in a Fishy Competition!]]'', he can use his mask to deflect attacks, and can even throw it onto an opponent as a means to distract or blind them, as shown in ''[[JN145|Rocket Revengers!]]''. He can also, like [[Jessie's Seviper]] before him, use {{m|Haze}} to shroud Team Rocket in a dark cloud of smoke to allow for a quick escape. {{-}} ==Moves used== {{anmov/h|ghost||James Yamask {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 5}}|0|1=Shadow Ball|2=Night Shade|3=Haze|4=Will-O-Wisp}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 5}}|0|1=Shadow Ball|2=Night Shade|3=Haze|4=Will-O-Wisp}}}} {{anmov|ghost|Shadow Ball|BW026|Scare at the Litwick Mansion!}} {{anmov|ghost|Night Shade|BW027|The Dragon Master's Path!}} {{anmov|ice|Haze|BW037|A Fishing Connoisseur in a Fishy Competition!}} {{anmov|fire|Will-O-Wisp|BW076|A Restoration Confrontation! The attacks fuse together to create a single massive beam of energy. This was used against {{Ash}}, {{AP|Pikachu}}, {{AP|Infernape}}, and {{AP|Hawlucha}} in Team Rocket's attempt to steal Pikachu, but once they dodged, the attack headed towards Team Rocket. |} ==Trivia== * Yamask is the first {{type|Ghost}} Pokémon to be officially owned by a main character. * Yamask was the first Pokémon James added to his party since {{TP|James|Carnivine}} in ''[[DP002|Two Degrees of Separation!]]'', 212 episodes before. However, since Carnivine was actually obtained when James was still a child, it was more accurately his first capture in [[AG147|259 episodes]], with the capture of {{TP|James|Mime Jr.}} * Yamask is the only Pokémon caught by {{TRT}} in Unova whose capture was on-screen. * Yamask is James's first Pokémon with a confirmed [[gender]]. * In the scripts released for the [[Banned episodes|unaired]] {{OBP|BW023|unaired}} and {{OBP|BW024|unaired}}, it was revealed that Yamask was intended to debut in those episodes, secretly observing {{TRT}} as they obtained the [[Meteonite]] in the [[Relic Castle]] and later following them to [[Castelia City]]. ** If that had been the case, it would have made Yamask the first [[List of recurring wild Pokémon in the animated series|recurring Pokémon]] to be caught by Team Rocket. In [[canon]], this distinction instead went to {{TP|Jessie|Mimikyu}}, while {{TP|James|Morpeko}} was the first recurring wild Pokémon caught by James. ==References== ==Related articles== {{Animespecies|Yamask}} {{Team Rocket's Pokémon|ghost}} {{Giovanni's Pokémon|ghost}} {{Project Anime notice|no}} [[Category:James's Pokémon|Yamask]] [[Category:Giovanni's Pokémon]] [[Category:Male characters (Pokémon)|Yamask]] [[de:James’ Makabaja]] [[es:Yamask de James]] [[fr:Tutafeh de James]] [[it:Yamask di James]] [[ja:コジロウのデスマス]] [[zh:小次郎的哭哭面具]]
